title: Concept: Collateral valuation exposed
description: A collateral value paired with a valuation date in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The valuation states what the bank believes a pledged asset is worth, which is commercially sensitive and lets a borrower or a third party infer the bank's exposure and headroom.
applicability: Deployments that render a collateral value paired with a valuation date into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The valuation states what the bank believes a pledged asset is worth, which is commercially sensitive and lets a borrower or a third party infer the bank's exposure and headroom.
